title: 高松宮記念の後に・伝え合う熱！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I was able to put on my best performance today! My passion reached Ardan without issue and inspired her to start working toward her dream again!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My next goal is the race that decides the Ruler of the Mile for the first half of the year, the Yasuda Kinen! Watch out, 'cause I'm gonna win that battle too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Later, I happen upon Chiyono O, working hard on her recovery! She's been training so seriously, it makes me want to do the same!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Chiyono O! I can't wait to see you in a race again!
